investigation_notes.Hash Reputation Summary: VirusTotal: 0 engines flagged | Community score -24 with 29 community votes labeled Malicious and 20 labeled Harmless (mixed community feedback, leans suspicious).
investigation_notes.Notable Recent Events: Shortly before the PowerShell execution there were commands enumerating local groups (net localgroup administrators) and a ProcessAccess event showing high-privilege access to lsass.exe (granted_access 0x1fffff), indicating possible credential discovery or theft activity.
investigation_notes.Description: An encoded PowerShell command was executed that decodes to an invocation which downloads and executes a remote script from http://172.16.8.92/PowerSpread.ps1. The process was spawned by wmiprvse.exe with no file path reported, suggesting possible direct-to-memory or script-based execution, and recent events show local group enumeration and high-privilege access to lsass.exe on the same host. The combination of an inline download+execute, suspicious parent process, evidence of credential access attempts, and community-leaning malicious hash feedback supports escalating this to High Priority for further investigation.
